detect.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no package.json, this is not a JavaScript or TypeScript project" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
printf '%s\n' "$pm"

enabledShifts.fallback: park unused-code suspects from static review; no automated dead-code report is available

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or the pinned range no longer resolves in the manager the lockfile names

packageManagerAdditions.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
declared="$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager"[^"]*"//p' package.json | cut -d@ -f1 | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "$declared" ] && [ "$declared" != "$pm" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: package.json names $declared, the lockfile names $pm" >&2
  exit 78
fi
ver="$(node -v 2>/dev/null)" || ver=""
major="${ver#v}"
major="${major%%.*}"
case "$major" in "" | *[!0-9]*) major=0 ;; esac
if [ "$major" -lt 20 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: this recipe needs Node 20 or newer, the host reports major $major" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm install --save-dev "knip@^5.0.0"; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm add --save-dev "knip@^5.0.0"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn add --dev "knip@^5.0.0"; fi

permissionRequirements: fallback: knip reports unused files and exports only; dynamic imports and external consumers stay unverified and must be parked

probe.command:
if [ -f knip.json ] || [ -f knip.ts ]; then exit 0; fi
if grep -qE '"knip"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
exit 1

rollback.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm uninstall knip
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm remove knip
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn remove knip
fi
rm -f knip.json

smoke.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm exec --no -- knip --no-exit-code
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm exec knip --no-exit-code
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn run knip --no-exit-code
else
  echo "nightshift: no lockfile, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
